newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: THIRD MEETING WITH EFTA TO START.
newsitem.headline: THIRD MEETING WITH EFTA TO START.

text.p: A joint committee of the European Free Trade Assisiation (EFTA) and Lithuania will hold a third meeting, the foreign ministry said on Thursday.
"The joint committee will review the functioning of the EFTA-Lithuania free trade agreemnet and its further implementation," the statement said.
The statement said the committee will also dicuss such issues as public procurement, rules of competition, services and foreign investment.
They will also exchange views on on economic developments and economic ties.
The EFTA delegation is headed by Ambassador Rudoph Ramsauer from the office of foreign economic affairs representing Switzerland, the country in the EFTA chair.
The secretary general of EFTA, Kjartan Johannsson, will also participate in the meeting, the statement said.
The free trade agreement between Lithuania and EFTA was signed in December 1995 and came into force in January 1997.
Foreign trade between Lithuania and EFTA states in 1996 was to a tiny 208 million litas.
